items.title: Equifax (EFX) Faces Complaint Portal Focus, Is It A Bargain?
items.summary: CFPB complaint portal changes put Equifax stock in focus The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau has tightened access to its complaint portal, now asking consumers to first dispute credit report errors directly with Equifax (EFX), Experian and TransUnion before escalating issues to the regulator. This process change draws fresh attention to how Equifax handles consumer disputes and data accuracy.
